fields.label: How this applies
fields.options:
Changing this does not rewrite existing numbers. Every Production Projection and Production Forecast records the rule it was generated under, and keeps reading its weeks that way.

To move an existing budget onto a new rule, regenerate it. Until you do, it stays on its original rule and its week numbers keep pointing at the dates they always did.
